<p class="project-page-intro">
Techniques for improving serving latency, throughput, memory efficiency,
time-to-first-token, and sustained decode performance.
</p>

<div class="project-stack">
  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/nano_vllm_pp" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Continuous Batching &amp; Chunked Prefill</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Token-budget scheduling in nano-vLLM with TTFT/TPOT/KV telemetry. Output throughput increased from 58 to 223 tokens/s (3.84×) versus single-sequence scheduling on 12 mixed-length Qwen3-0.6B requests.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/nano_vllm_pp" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Quantized Loading &amp; Storage</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">NF4 reduced loaded CUDA allocation from 1.11 to 0.50 GiB versus BF16. Evaluated INT8 loading and INT8/packed-INT4 storage prototypes, keeping memory measurements distinct from execution speedups.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/nano_vllm_pp" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Paged KV Cache &amp; Prefix Reuse</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Paged KV tables, refcounts, and parent-hash prefix caching audited over 1,500 seeded operations. Warm 256-token prefix reuse avoided 3,072 prefill tokens and reduced median TTFT from 139 to 34 ms; all 12 greedy outputs matched.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/torch-compile-internals" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Compiled LLM Inference</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">Qwen2.5-0.5B FP32 eight-step decode improved from 97.9 to 66.8 ms with CUDA Graphs disabled. Analyzed generated fusion and attention changes, checked maximum logit error of 6.1 × 10<sup>−5</sup>, and documented a separate compiled MLP latency regression.</span>
  </a>

  <a class="project-row-card" href="https://github.com/AmanPandey28/lpcv2026" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="project-row-title">Edge Precision &amp; Accuracy Tradeoffs</span>
    <span class="project-row-meta">MobileCLIP2-S2 FP16 deployment on Qualcomm QNN with device-output validation. Rejected calibrated W8A16 QDQ after image cosine similarity fell to 0.811, preserving retrieval accuracy as a deployment constraint.</span>
  </a>
</div>
